name: orrery
description: Work with an Orrery catalog: its MCP tools for reading the estate and running actions, plus skills for reading the catalog first, modelling on the shared names, and describing a repository's service in its orrery.yaml.

personal_key.title: Orrery personal key
personal_key.description: Make one on your Orrery hub: open the menu under your name in the top bar, then API keys. Kept in your system's secure store.
